'''Dor Gal-ram's flagship''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] commanded by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dor Gal-ram]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Gal-ram commanded the ship on the side of [[Ludo Kressh]] during the [[Battle of Khar Delba]], although Gal-ram was killed when [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] ordered the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] crew to betray and kill Gal-ram.
